# contextjsx CLI

Serve a definition file as an MCP server, or write its docs and skills

## `serve <file> [--http] [--port <port>]`

Serve a definition file as an MCP server

With --http, prints the URL and token as JSON; send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to the URL.

- `<file>` module whose default export is a defineApp
- `--http` serve on loopback HTTP instead of stdio
- `--port <port>` port, default any free

```sh
contextjsx serve ./app.ts
contextjsx serve ./dist/app.js --http
```

## `emit <file> [--out <out>] [--markdown] [--skills] [--all] [--index <index>] [--no-note]`

Write Markdown docs and SKILL.md files from a definition file

- `<file>` module whose default export is a defineApp
- `--out <out>` writes `<out>/docs` and `<out>/skills`; without it, lists
- `--markdown` write Markdown docs
- `--skills` write SKILL.md files
- `--all` write both
- `--index <index>` main docs page, default index.md
- `--no-note` generated marker, on by default

```sh
contextjsx emit ./app.ts --all
contextjsx emit ./app.ts --out . --all --index cli.md
contextjsx emit ./app.ts --out . --skills --no-note
```
